source.snippet: In VS Code I'm dealing a lot with data files, some of them with separators (like CSV) and some with fixed-width fields. For CSV files I use Rainbow CSV to display the columns in my file in different colors. Is there a similar extension to color the columns of a fixed-width file? (captured 2026-09-08)

problem_statement: Data analysts and developers who work with legacy fixed-width flat files in VS Code lack a column-coloring extension comparable to Rainbow CSV for CSVs, making it hard to visually parse and validate fixed-width records.
target_segment: Data analysts, ETL developers, and backend engineers at enterprises or agencies who regularly handle legacy fixed-width data formats (COBOL, mainframe exports, government feeds).
notes: Single post with no upvotes; signal is very weak. However, fixed-width file handling is a known pain in enterprise/government data pipelines where buyers exist (data teams at banks, insurers, government contractors). Rainbow CSV has 3M+ installs suggesting the broader category converts. Worth monitoring for recurrence before investing further. No explicit willingness-to-pay stated.
